state: External helper tested; not a runtime launcher or new backend release.

wire.canonicalUnsignedInteger: 0 or a nonzero ASCII digit followed by ASCII digits; all values must fit JavaScript safe integers. trace_id and samples are strictly positive.

public.receiveClock: observedAtMs is launcher receive time, separately from producer started_unix_ms.
public.traceMeaning: Opaque process-local diagnostic Record counter, never an account/request/action identifier. Equal trace IDs do not correlate across process instances.
public.rangeValidation: Let q=maxEndUs-maxStartUs. Require durationMs*1000 <= q <= durationMs*1000+1000 (upper inclusive), totalUs >= durationMs*1000, and totalUs+1 >= q. BigInt is used only after every numeric value is a safe nonnegative integer.
public.maxAndAggregation: durationMs is the floored maximum completed single occurrence of that stage, not its sum; samples and totalUs aggregate completed occurrences of that same stage. Nested stages can overlap and must not be added.
public.endpointRounding: Separate floor-to-microsecond endpoints may differ by one microsecond more than floor(max elapsed microseconds); totalUs may be q-1.
public.completedOnly: Record emits only completed spans when the record drops after original business guards. A stuck/ongoing holder, subthreshold span, or disabled producer can have no rows. No row is not proof of no stall.

capture.legacyCompatibility: Default false accepts original 3/4/7 Gateway formats plus Store10. Root integration uses original803387 base capture unchanged and new storeOnly:true second dataset. Legacy30 tests remain raw exact.
capture.targetedMalformedPolicy: Any line beginning with [gateway-slow-stage] and containing account_store is treated as targeted; malformed, unknown, unsafe or extra-field Store lines stop the capture once, publish no such line and mark incomplete. Unrelated stderr and unsupported legacy formats retain old filtering.
capture.boundsArePerCapture: Two parallel captures have separate bounds; new Store capture has allocation/format/write overhead. No zero-overhead claim.

validator.input: Ended independent Store JSONL as Buffer chunks; never original game raw or private data.
validator.sourceBindingRequiredByCaller: Pin helper, validator, terminal/status and ended Store file before/after; readEnded must be true for returned SHA to cover complete input.
validator.countProof: Compare actual ended rows and bytes with queued counters; do not call queued counts durable. Status/source validity remains separately bound by runtime integration.
